title: Sheep eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='68' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#5A6274'/>
  <rect x='42' y='68' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#5A6274'/>
  <rect x='55' y='68' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#5A6274'/>
  <rect x='65' y='68' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#5A6274'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='31' y='82' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3D4452'/>
  <rect x='41' y='82' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3D4452'/>
  <rect x='54' y='82' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3D4452'/>
  <rect x='64' y='82' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3D4452'/>
  <!-- fluffy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='10' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='43' r='11' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='41' r='11' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='47' r='10' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='58' r='9' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='63' r='8' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='9' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='71' r='9' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='67' r='8' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <!-- shadow under body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#C9CDD6' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='46' rx='12' ry='13' fill='#E8E3D8'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='35' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#D6CFC0' transform='rotate(-30 34 35)'/>
  <!-- woolly top of head -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='35' r='6' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='32' r='6' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='39' r='5' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='44' r='2.8' fill='#3D4452'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='43' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='51' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#F0D2C0'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='51' r='1' fill='#B88A76'/>
  <!-- mouth chewing -->
  <path d='M9 55 Q13 58 17 55' stroke='#B88A76' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: bright green leaves / grass clump being eaten -->
  <ellipse cx='8' cy='55' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#6BCB3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='7' cy='53' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8FE85A' transform='rotate(-20 7 53)'/>
  <ellipse cx='11' cy='53' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8FE85A' transform='rotate(20 11 53)'/>
  <!-- snack held near mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='7' cy='58' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#4FA82B'/>
  <!-- little front leg holding snack -->
  <rect x='22' y='60' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#E8E3D8' transform='rotate(20 22 60)'/>
  <rect x='21' y='72' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3D4452'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='54' r='6' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='50' r='4' fill='#F2F2F2'/>
</svg>
